Watch it before June 12, then stream USA vs. Paraguay live with a free Tubi account. The documentary is free. The match is free. The hub is live now.

items.heading: Destination World Cup 2026, Season 1, streaming now
items.paragraph: Marc Cucurella, Harry Wilson, and Weston McKennie are chasing the same tournament from very different places in their careers. Each one brings a different kind of pressure into the series, and the show doesn't flatten that. It's TV-PG, free on Tubi, and a strong entry point for fans who want more than the matchday version of the story.
